name: Youth Payment
description: A financial assistance product for eligible young people, incorporating activity obligations, youth money management, incentive payments, and comprehensive rules around qualifications, income, residence, absences, and sanctions.

attributes.summary: A financial assistance product for eligible young people, incorporating activity obligations, youth money management, incentive payments, and comprehensive rules around qualifications, income, residence, absences, and sanctions.
attributes.eligibility: Young people meeting age criteria (transitions at age 18); ordinarily resident in New Zealand with two years residence requirement; parental support gap; within specified cash asset limits; may qualify under exceptional circumstances; must meet activity requirements including secondary education, approved training, tertiary education, work-based learning, or part-time work.
attributes.payment_details: Payment distributed via payment cards and in-hand allowance; youth money management applies with option to opt out upon demonstrated financial competence; incentive payments available for earning activities.
attributes.obligations: Secondary education, approved training, tertiary education, work-based learning, or part-time work participation; maximum 28-day absence in any 52-week period with approved reasons for extended absence; sanctions include Grade 1, Grade 2, and 13-week non-entitlement period for activity obligation failures.
attributes.stand_down: Initial stand-down periods apply for activity obligation failures; Grade 1 and Grade 2 sanctions precede 13-week non-entitlement periods.
attributes.income_test: Subject to income testing; parental income and cash assets assessed as part of hardship criteria.
